evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies the internal HTTP server request handling in src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h.
rationale: Encapsulates the HTTP request state machine by removing HTTPRequest::SetState() and exposing a single Load() method.
